tasks.title: 1.1 Confirm Authorization & Rules of Engagement
tasks.objective: Record the signed authorization, engagement contacts, testing window, and rate limits that govern this assessment.

tasks.title: 1.2 Validate Scope Coverage & Testing Windows
tasks.objective: Confirm every in-scope target is authorized for the planned test types and agree on escalation contacts before any testing begins.

tasks.title: 2.1 Active Port & Service Discovery
tasks.objective: Identify open network ports and listening service banners on the target host within authorized rate limits.

tasks.title: 2.2 Web Content & Directory Discovery
tasks.objective: Identify exposed web routes, backup files, and static resources using wordlist discovery.

tasks.title: 3.1 Map Assets & Trust Boundaries
tasks.objective: Document the discovered assets, data flows, and trust boundaries so analysis focuses on what an attacker could reach.

tasks.title: 3.2 Prioritize the Attack Surface
tasks.objective: Rank which exposed services and endpoints deserve deeper review first, based on exposure and business impact.

tasks.title: 4.1 Transport Security & HTTP Header Audit
tasks.objective: Inspect target HTTP response headers for missing security controls and evaluate TLS configuration.

tasks.title: 4.2 Authentication Surface Analysis
tasks.objective: Check discovered authentication endpoints for secure credential handling, rate-limiting, and error message verbosity.

tasks.title: 5.1 Plan Authorized Proof-of-Concept Validation
tasks.objective: For each candidate issue, document a minimal, non-destructive validation plan that stays within scope and rate limits and requires human approval before execution.

tasks.title: 5.2 Record Validation Outcome & Evidence Capture
tasks.objective: After the analyst performs the approved validation manually, paste the captured output as evidence and record whether the issue is confirmed or refuted.

tasks.title: 6.1 Document Business Impact of Validated Findings
tasks.objective: For each validated finding, describe the realistic business impact using the captured evidence; no further target interaction is performed.

tasks.title: 6.2 Verify No Persistence & Clean Up Test Artifacts
tasks.objective: Confirm that the manual validation left no accounts, files, or configuration changes on the target and record the verification.

tasks.title: 7.1 Draft Findings With Evidence References
tasks.objective: Write each confirmed finding with severity, description, reproduction summary, remediation advice, and a link to its evidence artifact.

tasks.title: 7.2 Review Readiness & Deliver the Report
tasks.objective: Resolve readiness warnings, confirm the evidence register is complete, and deliver the signed engagement report.
